objective: Computation and proof attempt: the round as a function of its reading; every isometry keeping the reading on the static and reached pairs, its extension, and the next tables.
status: Supported 2026-11-19 (referee pending): what the round reads stated and proved (Lemma A: live junctions, loose counts, the family of live sets met by one junction); every one of 2,198 extensions of reading-keeping table isometries (57 reached carried pairs) is an isometry of the next tables; X1, X1', X2 held. Claim B (table version) not proved; Claim B* (equations version) proved. The 6 carried pairs without a reading-keeping isometry and 43 static pairs persist anyway.
title: What the round reads, and whether a keeping isometry extends
